results.input: 你好，我持中国护照，准备从香港申请英国旅游签证。
results.guarded_model_draft:
了解了，你打算去英国旅游。

先给你申请入口：GOV.UK 页面里的 Apply now 可以开始在线填表，未填完的表格可以保存。如果需要 Standard Visitor 签证，流程是在线申请、预约签证申请中心，再按要求完成身份核验和交材料。我们这里帮你梳理信息、核对材料并整理材料包；正式递交由你在官网完成。
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor/apply-standard-visitor-visa

results.input: 我在读大学，自己出钱。得等学校公布假期安排之后，才能告诉你哪天出发和回来。请先把需要的材料清单发给我。
results.guarded_model_draft:
了解了，你目前在读书，费用由你自己承担。

日期先留空，等你确定后再补。我们先整理其他信息。

你目前在读、自己承担费用，可以先准备学校的在读证明，以及能说明资金来源和可用资金的银行流水。前者帮助说明学习情况，后者用于核对旅行费用如何承担；预算数字本身不能代替资金证明。这是按你目前情况给的准备建议，不是所有人统一的强制清单。
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/visitor-visa-guide-to-supporting-documents/guide-to-supporting-documents-visiting-the-uk#demonstrating-personal-circumstances

接下来还需要这些材料；有哪份暂时拿不到，也可以直接告诉我：
- 有效护照或旅行证件
- 在读证明
- 访问目的的证明材料
- 可用资金及来源证明，例如银行流水
- 在申请所在地合法居留的证明

这是按你的情况列出的待补材料，不是所有申请人通用的强制清单。如果行程或资助情况有变化，我会再调整。

方便告诉我护照上的姓名吗？你的出生日期是什么？请写完整年月日。

results.input: Hello, I hold a Chinese passport and will apply from Hong Kong for a holiday in the UK.
results.guarded_model_draft:
Thanks, you're planning a holiday in the UK.

Here is the official starting point: choose Apply now on the GOV.UK page. You can save an unfinished form. If you need a Standard Visitor visa, apply online, book a visa application centre appointment, and follow the identity and document steps. We help organise and check your preparation pack; you submit the application on the official site.
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor/apply-standard-visitor-visa

Are you currently employed, studying or self-employed? Who will pay for the trip?

results.input: I'm a university student and paying for the trip myself. My trip has to wait for the university to publish the holiday schedule; I can't give arrival or departure days yet. Please send me the document checklist first.
results.guarded_model_draft:
Thanks, you're studying and you're paying for the trip yourself.

We can leave the dates open for now and collect the other details first.

As a self-funded student, you can start with a letter confirming your enrolment and bank statements showing accessible funds and their source. These help explain your circumstances and how you will pay for the trip; a budget figure is not funding evidence. This is preparation advice for your circumstances, not a universal mandatory checklist.
GOV.UK: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/visitor-visa-guide-to-supporting-documents/guide-to-supporting-documents-visiting-the-uk#demonstrating-personal-circumstances

We'll also need these documents. Let me know if any are difficult to obtain:
- Valid passport or travel document
- Evidence of your student status
- Evidence of the purpose of the visit
- Evidence of available funds and their source, such as bank statements
- Evidence of legal residence when applying outside the country of nationality

This is a preparation list for your circumstances, not a universal mandatory checklist. I'll adjust it if your travel or funding arrangements change.

What is your name as it appears in your passport? What is your full date of birth?
